name: Eunoia
source:
Following a 'forced retirement' of your knighthood, you discover a poor man caught in a poacher's trap - except this man is nothing like you have ever seen before. He's delicate, kind… and appears to be a unicorn.

When you are cursed while defending him, Atticus the unicorn takes you to his cottage and heals you. But healing from the wound is half the battle - more sinister transformations start to occur, and your honor and mettle are tested… will you succumb to the dragon that now lives in you, or will you let Atticus guide you towards a new life?

[From [url=https://nekoii-studio.itch.io/eunoia]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在被“强制退役”剥夺骑士身份后，你在林间发现了一名误入偷猎者陷阱的可怜男子——可这名男子与你平生见过的任何人都截然不同。他纤细、温柔……而且似乎是一只独角兽。

当你在保护他时不幸身中诅咒，独角兽阿提库斯将你带回自己的小屋悉心救治。然而抚平外伤仅仅成功了一半——更加凶险诡异的异变开始在你体内蔓延，你的荣耀与气节也迎来了严峻考验……你究竟会屈服于如今寄宿在体内的恶龙，还是让阿提库斯指引你迈向崭新的人生？

[摘自[url=https://nekoii-studio.itch.io/eunoia]itch.io[/url]]
